title: Build comprehensive CS1 decision intelligence v1
acceptance_criteria: Backend and Next food-decision surfaces share explicit versioned readiness, abstention, provenance, reason-code, and human-review semantics
Pre-pilot product surfaces do not expose achieved food-waste, cost, carbon, or water savings claims
All active food action/dashboard, fallback data, and registered decision UI surfaces respect the same claim firewall and provenance semantics
Heuristic planning bands are explicitly labeled POLICY_HEURISTIC and never described as calibrated confidence intervals
Decision readiness combines source health and method evidence state; SANDBOX_ONLY can never become PILOT_READY
EVALUATED_OFFLINE can become at most REVIEW_REQUIRED until explicitly promoted by evidence
A baseline evaluation framework supports naive historical and operator baselines without fabricating measured results
All forecast candidates are ranked on identical common-support service rows so sparse methods cannot omit difficult cases
Pilot scorecards enforce sample sufficiency, normalized waste reduction, sellout guardrails, override visibility, and data-quality checks
Machine-readable policy metadata includes policy version, model provenance, decision provenance, method eligibility, limitations, and reason codes
KREATE validation fails on reintroduction of unsupported food-impact claims or removal of the human gate
Technical experiment documentation distinguishes repository capability, model estimates, policy heuristics, and measured pilot evidence
Repository evidence records technical capability without promoting it to market or impact proof
Focused regression tests and repository validation lock the full CS1 decision-integrity contract
validation_commands: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
notes: Scope expanded by user request from minimal core to the broad CS1 Decision Intelligence v1 workstream.
No PMR, pilot, calibration, or achieved-impact result may be invented; infrastructure may be implemented before evidence exists.
Model point estimation, policy heuristics, technical benchmarks, and measured pilot evidence are separate evidence classes.
Active dashboard/actions, fallback data, and registered jury/food-waste UI surfaces are included to prevent provenance drift.
Method eligibility is a hard readiness gate: repository-generated XGBoost remains SANDBOX_ONLY until acceptable measured-target evaluation exists.
Baseline ranking uses identical common support across all candidates and reports support coverage explicitly.

Latest role-branch PR template retained semantically correct anti-fabrication wording but dropped two legacy validator literals; this task adds one automation-compatibility comment so current governance and KREATE validation agree.

Temporary .github/workflows/cs1-decision-validation.yml is reserved only to run exact-head validation on the CS1 branch and will be deleted before integration; final feature PR validation uses the normal role-targeted CI.
Does not intentionally modify .github/workflows/ci.yml; that file is inherited unchanged from the synchronized role branch.
